svg.title: SyMoNeuRaL Phase 0 — Post A/B/C Decision Before Re-measure
svg.desc: A/B/C commits passed. Before Phase 0.5, decide whether to repair Commit A's clipped message so the full-suite re-measure stamps final SHAs.
svg.text: SyMoNeuRaL Phase 0 — Post A/B/C Decision
Snapshot: 2026-08-22 09:39 EDT · A/B/C commit-output hold passed · one decision before 0.5
A/B/C hold: GREEN
The fold gate and commit-output gate both passed. Commits landed in order: C, B, A in log order.
C f29a1f68 · B 5a29352f · A b5731054 · residue: SMOKE + docs/specs/* + two zips
COMMIT GATE CLOSED
Current decision: repair Commit A message before 0.5?
Bash history expansion clipped the Commit A message at the (?<!Sub) lookbehind line.
Recommendation: repair now, before full-suite re-measure, so Phase 0.5 stamps final SHAs.
Use set +H and git commit --amend -F /tmp/msgA.txt, then rebase B/C onto the amended A.
DECISION BEFORE 0.5
Path 1 — Recommended: repair message
DO THIS IF SHAS ARE STILL LOCAL
Rewrite A only for message integrity, then replay B/C.
git checkout -q b5731054
git commit --amend -q -F /tmp/msgA.txt
NEWA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
git rebase --onto "$NEWA" b5731054 main
Then run Phase 0.5 on the final rewritten HEAD.
Path 2 — Defensible: skip repair
ONLY IF MESSAGE QUALITY IS ACCEPTABLE
The operational evidence already landed. The lesson survives elsewhere.
Phase 0.5 stamps current HEAD: f29a1f68
Do not rewrite later after deploy, external references, or more work.
Skipping is allowed, but the clipped log line remains permanent history.
Next after the decision: Phase 0.5 full-suite re-measure
Run from backend with both ignores, collect-only abort-check, remix separately, and paste the tail with the SHA.
apps/ -q --ignore=apps/studio/plugins/reinforce/tests --ignore=apps/remix/tests · collect-only · apps/remix pytest
HARD BOUNDARY:
no deploy · no Phase 1 · no docs/specs commit · no zips · no /review/ force-add until 0.5/0.6 gates classify green
